body:
This mod includes independent elements such as new mines, biomes, and the Paradise dimension. If you have any suggestions or complaints, please contact me at omergun2828@gmail.com

The mod elements are in Turkish; we are still working on English language support.

Mod Features:

- New ores

- New Mobs

- New Biomes

- New Items 

- New Food

- New Heaven Dimension

- New Structure

Frequently asked questions:

- How can I go to the Heaven dimension?

- You can't go there with a normal water bucket. Add glowstone powder to all four sides of the water bucket to make it a glow bucket and use it like a lighter.

Note: When you enter the portal, wait patiently for a while. Don't assume you can't go there just because there's no portal effect.
